serialization: u32be envelope length || raw HPKE encapsulation-and-ciphertext; high nibble first

inference.cache: reset and kv_cache_clear per sequence; serial prefill/eval

tokens.boundary: separate public context; canonical full carrier prefix at each emission
tokens.rank_order: descending native logits; ascending token ID for exact ties
tokens.vocabulary: public rank16 admissible alphabet within top 128; attribute mask 27
tokens.normalization: none; strict UTF-8; no strip or inserted space
tokens.stop: bounded public u32be length frame; no EOS stop or padding

cover_contexts: A field note about trees in the public garden:
A brief explanation of how a library organizes books:
A research note about measuring afternoon rainfall:

selection.order: descending native logits, ascending token ID for exact ties
selection.admissibility: strict UTF-8 of full detokenized proposed carrier prefix AND exact retokenization to proposed IDs
selection.candidate_selection: first 16 admissible among first 128 ranked IDs; stop scan once 16 found; no expansion or retry
selection.numerical_assumption: identical conditional candidate order across cleared-cache processes

framing.termination: exactly 2*(4+declared envelope length) received tokens; reject incomplete or trailing tokens
framing.length_validation: validate range and received token count before payload allocation
